description: This PHP source file defines the RecruitmentAttachmentDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It contains methods for managing recruitment-related attachments, including saving, retrieving, deleting, and querying attachments related to vacancies, candidates, and interviews. The class leverages Doctrine ORM for database interactions and is part of the recruitment plugin's data access layer.

classes.name: RecruitmentAttachmentDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class responsible for handling CRUD operations and complex queries related to recruitment attachments, including vacancy, candidate, and interview attachments within the OrangeHRM HR management system.

methods.name: saveVacancyAttachment
methods.description: Persists a VacancyAttachment entity and returns it.

methods.name: saveCandidateAttachment
methods.description: Persists a CandidateAttachment entity and returns it.

methods.name: saveInterviewAttachment
methods.description: Persists an InterviewAttachment entity and returns it.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentById
methods.description: Retrieves a VacancyAttachment entity by its ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingVacancyAttachmentIds
methods.description: Fetches a list of existing vacancy attachment IDs from a given list of IDs.

methods.name: getPartialCandidateAttachmentByCandidateId
methods.description: Retrieves a partial recruitment attachment related to a candidate by candidate ID.

methods.name: getCandidateAttachmentByCandidateId
methods.description: Retrieves the CandidateAttachment entity for a specific candidate ID.

methods.name: hasCandidateAttachmentByCandidateId
methods.description: Checks if a candidate has an attachment associated with the given candidate ID.

methods.name: getPartialInterviewAttachmentByAttachmentIdAndInterviewId
methods.description: Retrieves a partial recruitment attachment for an interview by attachment ID and interview ID.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentByAttachmentIdAndInterviewId
methods.description: Fetches a specific InterviewAttachment entity by attachment ID and interview ID.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentsByVacancyId
methods.description: Returns all recruitment attachments for a specific vacancy.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentsCountByVacancyId
methods.description: Counts the number of attachments for a given vacancy.

methods.name: deleteVacancyAttachments
methods.description: Deletes multiple vacancy attachments based on a list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteCandidateAttachment
methods.description: Deletes the attachment associated with a candidate.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachments
methods.description: Fetches interview attachments based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginated query for interview attachments based on search filters.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentsCount
methods.description: Counts the total number of interview attachments matching search filters.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentIdList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all interview attachment IDs.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentIdList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all vacancy attachment IDs.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentListForHiringManger
methods.description: Retrieves attachment IDs for vacancies associated with a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentListForHiringManger
methods.description: Retrieves attachment IDs for interviews associated with a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentListForInterviewer
methods.description: Retrieves attachment IDs accessible for a specific interviewer.

methods.name: getAccessibleInterviewIdsForInterviewer
methods.description: Helper method to fetch interview IDs accessible to an interviewer.

methods.name: getExistingInterviewAttachmentIdsForInterview
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing interview attachments for a specific interview.

methods.name: deleteInterviewAttachments
methods.description: Deletes specified interview attachments for a given interview ID.
